sentences.en: A strong wind is blowing and I can't walk fast.
sentences.zh: 强风刮着，我走不动快步。

sentences.en: I can no more swim than a fish can walk.
sentences.zh: 鱼儿都不会走路，我也一样不会游泳。

sentences.en: Last summer, I always took a walk in the morning.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我总是在早上散步。
